svg.title: What one page builder edit costs: the usual whole-field round trip versus Statamic MCP 0.8
svg.desc: Two bars. The usual way, fetching the whole field and sending it back, one edit cost 37.8 KB, about 9,450 tokens. With Statamic MCP 0.8, fetching one set and merging it by id, 5.0 KB, about 1,250 tokens. That is 7.5 times less, averaged over four pages.
svg.text: What one page builder edit costs
Changing one field of one block, averaged over four pages
The usual way, any tool that fetches the whole field and sends it back
Statamic MCP 0.8, one set fetched and merged by id
Measured over HTTP, the usual way through release 0.7 of this package. Tokens at 4 bytes each.
